terms.note: one term for reads and writes combined. Validated to 1.3% on a pure read stream at 5.5 GB/s; over-predicts 12-13% on a 50/50 read+write stream at 11 GB/s, because a written byte is charged the same as a read byte and evidently costs less. Splitting this into read and write coefficients is the known next refinement.

lands on vdd_soc. Direction-insensitive (103 mW/Gbps TX, 87 RX), so one term covers both; R^2 0.884 pooled over 6 points. This is the MAC, PHY interface, SerDes and NoC path - it is NOT DRAM traffic, and the dram term accounts for only ~2 mW of the ~90 mW measured at 900 Mbps. The CPU cost of the network stack is already covered by cores.active_cores and must not be counted again here. Measured at 1 GbE only: whether the coefficient is truly per-bit is untested at 2.5G/10G.
